description: This file implements functions for parsing and converting X.509 distinguished names, including handling of attribute types, string conversions, and RFC2253 formatting.

classes.name: X509NameAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute in an X.509 distinguished name, with methods for string conversion and parsing.

methods.name: OidToString
methods.description: Converts an OID input to its dotted string representation.

methods.name: ValueAsString
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as a string, handling various string types.

methods.name: ValueAsStringWithUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as a string with options for handling printable strings.

methods.name: ValueAsStringUnsafe
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as a string, assuming unsafe handling.

methods.name: AsRFC2253String
methods.description: Formats the attribute as an RFC 2253 string.

methods.name: ReadRdn
methods.description: Reads a Relative Distinguished Name from a parser.

methods.name: ParseName
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded name into a sequence of RDNs.

methods.name: ParseNameValue
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded name value into RDNs.

methods.name: ConvertToRFC2253
methods.description: Converts an RDN sequence to an RFC 2253 formatted string.
